title: General Services Agreement – Novogradac & Company LLP – Solar Investment Tax Credit - Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a General Services Agreement by and between the District and Novogradac & Company LLP, San Francisco, CA, for the latter to perform the following “Basic Services”: provide professional tax advisory services and Direct Pay filings for District solar energy projects (the "Project," as further described in Exhibit A to this Agreement) including preparation of cost segregation studies to determine ITC eligible energy property under IRC Section 48, analysis of project cost schedules and eligible basis, preparation of IRS Forms 990 T and 3468 and other required federal tax filings for fiscal years ending June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2027, and coordination with District staff to support successful submission of Direct Pay claims; provide services related to the Project other than Basic Services (i.e., "Additional Services") if directed in writing by District to perform specific Additional Services and if sufficient contract funds for Additional Services remain to pay for the directed Additional Services …, with Additional Services subject to a written agreement executed by Contractor and District, in an amount not to exceed $58,000.00, with the work scheduled to be performed pursuant to Section 3 - Term - of the Agreement, via Facilities Planning and Management.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Ratifies up to $58,000 for Novogradac to prepare federal solar tax credit filings for district solar projects
summary: Novogradac & Company LLP will give tax advice and prepare federal tax filings so the district can claim solar investment tax credits as direct payments for its solar energy projects. The work covers fiscal years ending June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2027, and includes studies to find which project costs qualify. The board is ratifying the agreement, meaning it is approving it after the fact, and it is paid from Measure Y building bond funds.

title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Next Generation of Builders, LLC – Markham Elementary School Boys Toilet Renovation Project – Buildings and Grounds Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Next Generation of Builders, LLC, Santa Clara, CA, for the latter to provide additional work for PCO#lO Hallway Tile Abatement and Drinking fountain and PCO# 11 Trim/Cleaning Around Windows, Ceiling, and paint for the Markham Elementary School Boys Toilet Renovation Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $19,743.61, increasing the contract price from $250,271.39 to $270,015.00. The Change Order also extends the contract term from July 29, 2026, through August 21, 2026, to September 30, 2026, an extension of forty (40) calendar days. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain unchanged and in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $19,743.61 for tile removal and finish work on Markham Elementary boys' restroom renovation
summary: This change order pays Next Generation of Builders for extra work on the Markham Elementary School boys' restroom renovation: removing hallway tile and a drinking fountain, plus trim, cleaning, ceiling and paint work around windows. These items come from two preliminary change orders (proposed changes to the construction contract). The contract price rises from $250,271.39 to $270,015.00, and the end date moves from August 21, 2026 to September 30, 2026, which adds 40 days.

title: Change Order No. 2, Design Build Contract – Gridscape Solutions, Inc. - Solar Photovoltaics Phase 2 - Various School Sites Project - Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 2, Design Build Contract by and between the District and Gridscape Solutions, Inc., Fremont CA, for the latter to process PCO#2 - Additional PG&E fees for the Power Shutdowns And Concrete Pad Demolition, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the Solar Photovoltaic Phase 2 at various school site projects, in the not-to-exceed amount of $25,029.31, increasing the Contract amount from $3,866,363.00 to $3,891,392.31. All other terms and conditions of the Contract remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $25,029.31 to Gridscape's school solar contract for PG&E shutdown fees and concrete pad removal

The costs are added PG&E fees for power shutdowns and the demolition of a concrete pad, listed as preliminary change order (PCO) #2. The contract total rises from $3,866,363.00 to $3,891,392.31.

title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – DecoTech Systems, Inc. - Lincoln Elementary School Security Improvement Project - Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and DecoTech Systems, Inc., Walnut, CA, for the latter to  provide a Dell PowerEdge R760 server, in lieu  of the manufacture’s discontinued  Dell PowerEdge R570 server, as described in the supporting documentation and identified in Proposed Change Order No. 1, for the Lincoln Elementary School Security Improvement Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $16,424.00 (server cost differential), increasing Agreement price from $101,854.00 to $118,278.00. presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $16,424 to DecoTech's Lincoln Elementary security project to swap in a newer server model

title: Agreement for General Services – Project Support Services – DSA Legacy - Facilities Planning and Management Project - Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for General Services by and between the District and Project Support Services, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide specialized Division of the State Architect (DSA) closeout and certification services for The DSA Legacy Project, as further described in the Proposal, which is attached as Exhibit A, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth,  and shall provide services other than Basic Services (i.e., "Additional Services") if directed in writing by District to perform specific Additional Services and if sufficient contract funds for Additional Services remain to pay for the directed Additional Services, in the not-to-exceed amount of $105,000.00, with work scheduled to commence on November 13, 2026 and scheduled to last until June 30, 2027.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires Project Support Services for up to $105,000 to close out and certify older state-reviewed building projects
summary: Project Support Services of Oakland will handle closeout and certification work with the Division of the State Architect (DSA), the state office that reviews school construction, for older district building projects (the "DSA Legacy Project"). It may also do extra work if the district asks in writing and money remains. Work runs from November 13, 2026 to June 30, 2027, paid from Measure J bond funds.

title: Site Use Agreement - The City of Oakland - Fire Department - Training on District Property - Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Site Use Agreement by and between the District and the City of Oakland, on behalf the Oakland Fire Department (OFD), for the latter’s temporary training use of the District’s vacant property at 1025 2nd Avenue (with a process for adding other District properties through written amendments), for periodic access for OFD firefighter training and professional development, pursuant to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, for the term effective November 13, 2026, for a period of one (1) year, unless earlier until terminated in accordance with this Agreement.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

Other district properties could be added later through written amendments. The agreement runs for one year starting November 13, 2026, unless it is ended earlier. The text does not state any payment.

title: Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – OBR Electric, LLC– Montera Middle School Site Improvements Project – Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and OBR Electric, LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide labor, material and equipment for corrective base preparation and electrical infrastructure; includes one 20-amp, 208-volt lighting feed and one 120-volt control circuit from the existing panel to the Musco cabinet, including approximately 100 feet of interior 1-inch EMT and 200 feet of exterior underground 2-inch PVC for the Montera Middles School Mini-Pitch site as part of the Montera Middle School Site Improvements Project, in the amount of $73,348.00, which includes a contingency allowance of $6,668.00, with the work anticipated to commence on November 13, 2026, and with an anticipated ending of December 13, 2026.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires OBR Electric for $73,348 in electrical and base work for Montera Middle School's mini-pitch
summary: OBR Electric, an Oakland contractor, will provide labor, materials and equipment to prepare the ground and run electrical lines for lighting at the Montera Middle School mini-pitch. The work is part of the school's site improvements project. The $73,348 total includes a $6,668 contingency allowance, and the work is expected to run from November 13 to December 13, 2026.

title: Amendment No. 3, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction – T.Y.R., Inc. – Manzanita Elementary School - California Fire Implementation Project - Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 3, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction by and between the District and T.Y.R., Inc., Huntington Beach, CA, for the latter to continue to provide Inspector of Record Services for the Manzanita Elementary School - California Fire Implementation Project, including additional inspection services associated with the Division of the State Architect (DSA) review and approval of accessible path of travel updates for play structures, in an additional amount of $2,100.00, increasing the not-to-exceed amount of Agreement from $32,634.00 to $34,734.00, and extending the term of the Agreement from May 29, 2025 through June 30, 2025 to February 28, 2027. title: Amendment No. 4, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction – T.Y.R., Inc. – Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School - California Fire Implementation Project - Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 4,  Agreement for Inspector of Record Services by and between the District and T.Y.R., Inc., Huntington Beach, CA, for the latter to provide additional DSA-certified Inspector of Record services associated with the Division of the State Architect (DSA) review and approval of accessible path of travel updates for play structures at the Martin Luther King, Jr., Elementary School California Fire Implementation Project, as outlined in the proposal dated August 28, 2026, attached to this Amendment as Exhibit A, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, in the amount of $2,100.00, increasing the Agreement not to exceed amount from $22,701.00 to $24,801.00, and extending the term of the Agreement from May 29, 2025, through June 30, 2026 to February 28, 2027. presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $2,100 for T.Y.R. inspector work on King Elementary play structure upgrades, extends to Feb. 2027

It also covers removing a tree that fell during soil preparation for the nature area and posed a safety hazard, and planting a district-supplied replacement, with irrigation. title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Axis Mundi Center for Mental Health - Hoover Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Axis Mundi Center for Mental Health, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide therapists to work with students individually and in groups, on building the Social Emotional Learning skills necessary to regulate emotions and have healthy relationships; work with school staff to assess needs, provide consultations and training as needed at Hoover Elementary School, for the period of August 10, 2026 through May 28, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $25,000.00.

summary: Axis Mundi Center for Mental Health will provide therapists who work with Hoover Elementary students one-on-one and in groups to build skills for managing emotions and having healthy relationships. vendor_name: Axis Mundi Center for Mental Health

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Aniya Williams - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Aniya Williams, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide 444 hours of specialized professional learning and conference development services for the Expanded Learning 2027 Summer Institute, including the design and development company Institute's professional learning framework and session structure; preparation and coordination of facilitators and presenters; development opportunities of learning resources; stakeholder and implementation coordination; onsite Institute support and post-Institute evaluation and recommendations (with programs that collectively serve 18,000 District students), via the Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of November 2, 2026 through August 27, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $20,000.00.
headline: Pays a contractor up to $20,000 to plan and run the 2027 Expanded Learning Summer Institute for program staff
summary: An individual contractor will provide 444 hours of work designing and running the district's 2027 Expanded Learning Summer Institute, a professional learning event for after-school and summer programs that together serve about 18,000 OUSD students. The work includes planning sessions, coordinating presenters, creating learning materials, onsite support and an evaluation afterward, from November 2, 2026 through August 27, 2027. The board is ratifying this agreement after the service period had already begun.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Dynamic Education Services, Inc. - Special Education Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between Dynamic Education Services, Inc., Placentia, CA, for the latter to provide Special Education services - Compensatory/Supplemental Services, Reading Intervention Program, Mathematics Intervention Program, Transition 2 Life & Daily Living Skills Program, and School-Based Support Services (Exhibit A) -, for the period of November 2, 2026, through June 30, 2027, via the Special Education Department, in an amount not to exceed $35,000.00.
headline: Pays Dynamic Education Services up to $35,000 for tutoring, intervention and life-skills services for special-ed students
summary: Dynamic Education Services, Inc. will provide special education services through the Special Education Department. These include make-up (compensatory) and supplemental services, reading and math intervention, a life and daily living skills transition program, and school-based support. The agreement runs from November 2, 2026, through June 30, 2027, and the Board is ratifying it, meaning it is approving an agreement that is already in place.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Ball for Life Oakland LLC - Piedmont Avenue Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Ball for Life Oakland LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide a physical education and recess support program for students; assign a program manager to liaise with school leadership, support staff, gather data, create newsletters, recruit and train coaches at Piedmont Avenue Elementary School, for the period of October 2, 2026 through May 27, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $70,000.00.
headline: Pays Ball for Life Oakland up to $70,000 for PE and recess support at Piedmont Avenue Elementary
summary: Ball for Life Oakland will run a physical education and recess support program for students at Piedmont Avenue Elementary School. A program manager will work with school leaders and staff, gather data, write newsletters, and recruit and train coaches. The agreement runs from October 2, 2026 through May 27, 2027.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Community Roots Curriculum Services, LLC - Office of Equity
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Community Roots Curriculum Services, LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide professional development - Foundational Training for Lit Kings/Queens Facilitators and Central Office Staff and On-site Foundational Training for school literacy teams and school leaders involving 8-12 schools: Allendale, Bella Vista, Chabot, Hoover, Laurel, Lockwood, Manzanita CS, Manzanita SEED, Markham, Piedmont Ave,, Prescott, Sankofa, and related activities, specified in the Scope of Work (Lit Kings & Queens: Targeted Literacy Acceleration), incorporated herein by reference - promoting accelerated reading growth for students to Exist Tier 2 SIPPS or for passing two levels in one year, via Office of Equity, for the period of October 6, 2026 through May 28, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for Community Roots Curriculum Services to train literacy teams at 8–12 schools
summary: Community Roots Curriculum Services will train "Lit Kings/Queens" reading facilitators, central office staff, and school literacy teams and leaders at 8 to 12 schools, aiming to speed up students' reading growth. The service period runs October 6, 2026 to May 28, 2027, and is paid through the Office of Equity. This is a ratification, so the work began before the board's approval.
schools: Allendale; Bella Vista; Chabot; Hoover; Laurel; Lockwood; Manzanita CS; Manzanita SEED; Markham; Piedmont Ave; Prescott; Sankofa

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Dennis Chaconas - Allendale Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Dennis Chaconas, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide consulting service support to build the capacity of the  leadership team to build collective efficiency among teacher teams;  assist the Principal, Teacher on Special Assignment (TSA), and Community School Manager (CSM) in planning full-day professional trainings, weekly 1-1 coaching meetings between leaders and teachers, and weekly professional learning community meetings between leaders and grade-level teams to help leaders engage teachers in data-driven decision-making and attending to student outcomes at Allendale Elementary School, for the period of October 15, 2026 through May 14, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $5,000.00.
headline: Pays a consultant up to $5,000 to coach Allendale Elementary leaders on teacher teamwork and data use
summary: An individual consultant will help Allendale Elementary School's principal and leadership team plan full-day teacher trainings, weekly one-on-one coaching and weekly grade-level team meetings focused on using data and improving student outcomes. The agreement runs from October 15, 2026 through May 14, 2027. The board is ratifying it, which means it is approving an agreement whose period began before this vote.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Oakland Public Education Fund, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide stipends for Master's level interns who provide mental health services for students, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of October 5, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $136,400.00.

headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $136,400 for stipends to student mental health interns
summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will pay stipends to master's-level interns who provide mental health services to students, through the Community Schools and Student Services Department. The cost is up to $136,400, paid from Alameda Alliance for Health and federal mental health counseling funds.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Oakland Public Education Fund, Oakland, CA, for the latter to support the OUSD Violence Prevention Program by providing financial compensation to approximately 15 middle and high school students who are a part of the OUSD Student Committee for Safety and Violence Prevention subgroup of the Student Health Advisory Committee, as described in Exhibit A, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of January 1, 2027 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00.
headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $15,000 to compensate student members of a violence prevention committee
summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will pay about 15 middle and high school students for their work on the OUSD Student Committee for Safety and Violence Prevention. The committee is part of the Student Health Advisory Committee and supports the district's Violence Prevention Program. The agreement runs from January 1, 2027 through June 30, 2027.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Karen Schoonmaker - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Karen Schoonmaker, Sacramento, CA, for the latter to facilitate the Labor Trafficking curriculum for staff, provide training and support teachers online by zoom when the teachers are preparing for delivery of the Human Trafficking Prevention or Labor Trafficking curriculum for youth, contribute to developing family toolkits on human trafficking and digital safety curriculum, and serve as a lived-experience and curriculum expert in developing train-the-trainer materials for prevention workshops and trainings, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of September 21, 2026 through November 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $12,750.00.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Moira De Nike - Community Schools and Student Services Department

headline: Ratifies up to $29,611 for Children Rising to pilot Circle of Care Services at two more elementary schools

title: Amendment No. 3, Student Behavioral Health Incentive Program (SBHIP) - Memorandum of Understanding - Alameda Alliance for Health - Community Schools and Student Services Department

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Yolanda Silva - Early Childhood Development Department

The contract runs from October 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, and the board is approving it after the work period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Northeastern University - Academics and Instruction Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Northeastern University, Boston, MA, for the latter to provide the Library Leadership Team staff guidance and resources to support nutrition, as described in the 2026-27 Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Academics and Instruction Department, for the period of September 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $28,950.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $28,950 for Northeastern University to guide and support the district's Library Leadership Team
summary: Northeastern University of Boston will give the district's Library Leadership Team staff guidance and resources, which the agreement describes as supporting nutrition. The work runs from September 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027, through the Academics and Instruction Department. This is a ratification, so the work began before the board's vote.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Elevate Tutoring - West Oakland Middle School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Elevate Tutoring, San Jose, CA, for the latter to provide a team of tutors to support students with rigorous academic work in math and science classes; help students with homework and projects in their after-school program; be in classes and in ASP 4-5 days per week at West Oakland Middle School, for the period of August 27, 2026 through May 27, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $3,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $3,000 for Elevate Tutoring to tutor math and science students at West Oakland Middle School
summary: Elevate Tutoring will provide a team of tutors to help West Oakland Middle School students with math and science classwork, and with homework and projects in the after-school program, 4-5 days per week. The agreement runs from August 27, 2026 through May 27, 2027 and costs up to $3,000. The board is ratifying, or approving after the fact, an agreement whose service period began before this vote.

title: Grant Award – California Department of Education - Learning Communities for School Success Program Cohort 10 - Community Schools & Student Services Department
official_text: Acceptance by the Board of Education of a Learning Communities for School Success Program (LCSSP): Cohort 10 Grant Award from the California Department of Education, to support the OUSD Violence Prevention Program via the Community Schools and Student Services Department, CDE Grant Number: 26-25366-61259-00, in the amount of $1,699,750.00, for the period of July 1, 2026, through December 31, 2029, pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof, if any.
headline: Accepts $1.7M California Department of Education grant for OUSD's violence prevention program through 2029
summary: The district is accepting a $1,699,750 state grant from the California Department of Education's Learning Communities for School Success Program (Cohort 10). The money supports OUSD's Violence Prevention Program, run by the Community Schools and Student Services Department. The grant covers July 1, 2026, through December 31, 2029.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Blueprint Schools Network - MetWest High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Blueprint Schools Network, Needham, MA, for the latter to support with systems development and planning by collaborating with each school to develop schedules, systems, and processes for a successful implementation of the program, customizing Common Core-aligned curricular materials to ensure tutorial sessions complement and support OUSD’s curriculum, coordinate with school administration on order fulfillment for furnishings and other materials necessary for program implementation, and collaborating with administration to identify dedicated tutorial space and communicate expectations for appropriate tutorial learning environments for 2026-27; work with 9th grade and targeted students that will participate in the initiative based on school priorities, build the capacity of staff members with the intent of establishing long-term school-based support and infrastructures, design and implement a quality math acceleration program based on high dosage tutoring, provide a team to prepare for and support the implementation of a quality program; and recruit and train staff with professional development, with implementation beginning prior to the start of the 2026-27 school year through planning, scheduling, tutorial roster development, and program preparation activities at MetWest High School, for the period of August 12, 2026 through May 28, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00.
headline: Pays Blueprint Schools Network up to $50,000 for a 9th-grade math tutoring program at MetWest High School
summary: Blueprint Schools Network will set up and run a high-dosage math tutoring program for 9th graders and other targeted students at MetWest High School. The work includes planning schedules, adapting Common Core-aligned materials to fit OUSD's curriculum, and recruiting and training tutoring staff. The agreement runs from August 12, 2026 through May 28, 2027, and planning began before the school year started.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Girls Inc. of Alameda County - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Girls Inc. of Alameda County, Oakland, CA for the latter to deliver Expanded Learning for up to 60 girls across two elementary schools and one middle school through twice-weekly sessions focused on academic, social-emotional, and leadership development, build participants confidence, resilience, healthy relationships, leadership, self-advocacy and academic skills through gender-responsive, trauma-informed programming using the Strong, Smart, and Bold framework, and  provide two educational field trips for up to 40 participants and host three Student Showcase events to celebrate student growth and achievements, via the Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of September 21, 2026 through May 31, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $60,000.00.
headline: Pays Girls Inc. of Alameda County up to $60,000 for an expanded learning program for up to 60 girls
summary: Girls Inc. of Alameda County will run twice-weekly expanded learning sessions for up to 60 girls at two elementary schools and one middle school. The sessions focus on academic skills, social-emotional growth and leadership, and include two field trips for up to 40 students and three student showcase events. The agreement runs from September 21, 2026 through May 31, 2027.

title: No-Cost Services Agreement 2026-2027 - California State University (CSU), Fresno - Health Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a No-Cost Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and California State University (CSU), Fresno, Fresno, CA, for OUSD School Nurses to mentor another OUSD School Nurse attending CSU, Fresno, for the school nurse credentialing program, fulfilling the University's requirements for completion of the practicum courses, via Health Services Department, for the period of August 24, 2026, through June 30, 2027, at no cost to the District.
headline: Ratifies no-cost agreement with CSU Fresno for OUSD school nurses to mentor a colleague in its credential program
summary: OUSD school nurses will mentor another OUSD school nurse who is enrolled in California State University, Fresno's school nurse credential program, so that nurse can complete the university's required practicum courses. The agreement runs from August 24, 2026, through June 30, 2027, through the Health Services Department, at no cost to the district. The board is ratifying it after the period had already begun.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Chapter 510 Ink - Academics and Instruction Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Chapter 510 Ink, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide creative writing and poetry programming for students and teachers at East Oakland Pride, Highland, Grass Valley, Piedmont Avenue, Lockwood STEAM Academy, REACH Academy, Allendale, and Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary Schools, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via the Academics and Instruction Department, for the period of November 10, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $40,000.00.
headline: Pays Chapter 510 Ink up to $40,000 for creative writing and poetry programs at eight elementary schools
summary: Chapter 510 Ink, an Oakland nonprofit, will provide creative writing and poetry programming for students and teachers at eight elementary schools, including East Oakland Pride, Highland and Allendale. The agreement runs from November 10, 2026 through June 30, 2027, and is managed by the Academics and Instruction Department. The board is ratifying it, and the service period began two days before the vote.
schools: East Oakland Pride Elementary School; Highland Elementary School; Grass Valley Elementary School; Piedmont Avenue Elementary School; Lockwood STEAM Academy; REACH Academy; Allendale Elementary School; Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Community Initiatives - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Community Initiatives, Oakland, CA, for the latter to partner with Oakland Unified School District (OUSD) to implement a comprehensive mentoring initiative across up to eight high schools, training 70 high school students throughout the academic year and summer, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of October 5, 2026 through June 4, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $80,000.00.
headline: Pays Community Initiatives up to $80,000 to run a mentoring program at up to eight high schools
summary: Community Initiatives will partner with the district on a mentoring program at up to eight high schools, training 70 high school students during the school year and summer. The work runs from October 5, 2026 through June 4, 2027 and is managed by the Community Schools and Student Services Department. The board is approving this after the service period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Lend A Hand Foundation - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Lend A Hand Foundation, Oakland, CA, for the latter to partner with the Oakland Unified School District McKinney-Vento Program to provide educational and basic-needs support, including clothing, hygiene products, school supplies, and event tabling, to students and families experiencing housing instability, removing barriers to school attendance, participation and student success by providing essential resources throughout the school year, more specifically stated in Exhibit A, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of November 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $20,000.00.
headline: Pays Lend A Hand Foundation up to $20,000 for clothing, hygiene and school supplies for students without stable housing
summary: Lend A Hand Foundation will work with the district's McKinney-Vento Program, which serves students and families experiencing housing instability, to provide clothing, hygiene products, school supplies and event tabling so these students can attend and take part in school. The agreement runs from November 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027. The board is ratifying it, meaning the service period began before this vote.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - YouthBeat - MetWest High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and YouthBeat, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide support for media elective classes, including MetWest Live and Art-Yearbook, twice per week for approximately 50 students with services that include 37 hours of program coordination, 40 hours of curriculum development, and support from a Teaching Artist, with expected outcomes delineated in Exhibit A of the Agreement, at MetWest High School, for the period of August 17, 2026 through May 28, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $23,908.00.
headline: Pays YouthBeat up to $23,908 to support media elective classes at MetWest High School in 2026-27
summary: YouthBeat will support MetWest High School's media elective classes, including MetWest Live and Art-Yearbook, twice a week for about 50 students. The work includes program coordination, curriculum development and a teaching artist. The agreement runs from August 17, 2026 through May 28, 2027.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Aniya Williams - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Aniya Williams, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide planning guidance and logistical support for Professional Learning Communities (PLCs) over the course of the school year, working in conjunction with the District’s Expanded Learning Office, including project management, facilitation, and providing on-site technical assistance to ensure each PLC meets its intended learning objectives, more specifically described in the detailed Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of October 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $40,000.00.
headline: Pays a contractor up to $40,000 to plan and support Expanded Learning Office professional learning communities
summary: An individual contractor will plan, organize and facilitate professional learning communities (PLCs) with the district's Expanded Learning Office, including project management and on-site technical help so each group meets its learning goals. The agreement runs from October 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, and the board is approving it after the work period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Emdee Global - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Emdee Global, Pinole, CA, for the latter to provide 600 hours of specialized professional learning design, conference development, stakeholder preparation, implementation, and evaluation services for the Expanded Learning 2027 Summer Institute, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via the Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of November 2, 2026 through August 27, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $40,000.00.
headline: Pays Emdee Global up to $40,000 to design and run the 2027 Expanded Learning Summer Institute
summary: Emdee Global will provide 600 hours of work to plan, prepare, run and evaluate the Expanded Learning 2027 Summer Institute, a professional learning conference, for the Community Schools and Student Services Department. The agreement runs from November 2, 2026 through August 27, 2027, and is paid from Expanded Learning Opportunities Program funds. The board is ratifying the agreement, so the service period began before this vote.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Bay Area Community Resources - Rudsdale Continuation High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, El Cerrito, CA, for the latter to provide targeted, trauma-informed legal advocacy and violence prevention services for justice-involved, newcomer, unaccompanied, and undocumented students, including attending and advocating at court hearings, coordinating with legal immigration systems, providing referrals and documentation support, facilitating conflict resolution and safety interventions, and, lastly, collaborating with the Coordination of Services Team (COST) to align with the safety team and reduce justice system involvement, improve attendance, and increase graduation outcomes at Rudsdale Continuation High School, for the period of September 13, 2026 through May 31, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $22,500.00.
headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $22,500 for legal advocacy and violence prevention at Rudsdale
summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide trauma-informed legal advocacy and violence prevention for justice-involved, newcomer, unaccompanied and undocumented students at Rudsdale Continuation High School. Services include going to court hearings with students, working with immigration legal systems, referrals, conflict resolution and safety support, coordinated with the school's student support team. The agreement runs from September 13, 2026 through May 31, 2027, with the goal of reducing justice system involvement and improving attendance and graduation.

title: California Department of Social Services – Office of Immigrant Youth - Grant/Standard Agreement – Opportunities for Youth Program - Office of English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement (ELLMA)
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Grant/Standard Agreement (OFY-RRFP-2025-OUSD) by and between the California Department of Social Services, on behalf of its  Community Integration Unit, and District, with the latter accepting up to $756,000.00 in funding to support Immigrant Youth including Unaccompanied Undocumented Minors, and their families  - Case Management, Program Navigation, Outreach, Communication Support, Mental Health and Wellness Supports -  for the term  January 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, via the Office of English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement (ELLMA).
headline: Accepts up to $756,000 from California Department of Social Services to support immigrant youth and families
summary: The district will receive up to $756,000 from the California Department of Social Services to support immigrant youth, including unaccompanied undocumented minors, and their families. The money pays for case management, help navigating programs, outreach, communication support, and mental health and wellness supports, run through the district's Office of English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement. The grant covers January 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, so the period began before this approval.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027- UpFront Interpreting - Risk Management Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and UpFront Interpreting, Alamo, CA, for the latter to provide support for OUSD employees who are Deaf and hard-of-hearing to ensure effective interaction between students, staff, and families; assist with American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation, captioning services, and written communication for both staff and students; interpret during teaching lessons, Individualized Education Program (IEP) meetings, parent conferences, teacher collaboration sessions, professional development meetings, and for any other District staff or individual requiring communication support; ensure that the District remains in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) by providing reasonable accommodations and facilitating accessible communication in all educational and work-related settings, via the Risk Management Department, for the term of October 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $110,000.00.
headline: Pays UpFront Interpreting up to $110,000 for sign language and captioning support for Deaf and hard-of-hearing staff
summary: UpFront Interpreting will provide American Sign Language (ASL) interpreting, captioning and written communication support for district employees who are Deaf or hard-of-hearing. This covers lessons, Individualized Education Program (IEP) meetings, parent conferences and staff meetings, and helps the district meet the Americans with Disabilities Act. The agreement runs October 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027 and is being approved after the service period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - School Services of California - General Counsel
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and School Services of California, Sacramento, CA, for the latter to work proactively to protect and advance the District's interest in Sacramento, including developing strategies, monitoring legislation and budget items that impact OUSD; lobbying the Legislature and State Administration; meet with both Board Directors and district administrative leadership twice monthly and with district administrative leadership once monthly to provide timely updates and to assist OUSD with policy implementation, position writing, or other issues, as needed; schedule necessary meetings with local leadership, as well as coordinate legislative meetings for the BOE and OUSD staff traveling to Sacramento, as stated in Exhibit A, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Office of the General Counsel, for the period of July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, in an amount not to exceed $119,100.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $119,100 for School Services of California to lobby in Sacramento for OUSD through 2028
summary: School Services of California will represent the district's interests in Sacramento. It will track state laws and budget items that affect OUSD, lobby the Legislature and state officials, meet regularly with board members and district leaders, and set up meetings for staff traveling to Sacramento. The agreement runs July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, and because this is a ratification, the period began before the board vote.
source_issue: The title and action text call this a 2026-2027 agreement, but the stated term runs two years, from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, for a single not-to-exceed amount of $119,100.00.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027- Syreeta Mussante - District 3 Director, Board of Education
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Syreeta Mussante, Patterson, CA, for the latter to perform support or constitute services, and/or tasks, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for Board of Education, Director 3, VanCedric Williams, for the period November 1, 2026 through  April 30, 2027, on an as needed basis, in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00.
headline: Pays a contractor up to $15,000 for as-needed support services for Board Director VanCedric Williams (District 3)
summary: This agreement pays an individual contractor from Patterson, CA, up to $15,000 to provide as-needed support services and tasks for District 3 Board Director VanCedric Williams. The work is described in an exhibit to the agreement and runs from November 1, 2026, through April 30, 2027. It is paid from the district's general-purpose funds.
